meaning: Titles and reading notes drafted by an AI agent in the register of the paper they annotate. No mathematician has reviewed them.

notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.HeightPr: The expression is defined by choice when admissible coefficients exist and by zero otherwise; this lemma only transports that definition across equal predicates.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.MeshFarI: This is a data-record update used for an empty band, so the zeroed fields should be read together with the empty-band case in the enclosing proof.
The result compares the total infinite-sum operation and does not assert that the smaller family is summable; a separate summability statement is available in this route.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.DataA: The scalar correction is chosen before the layout and applies uniformly to every permitted layout with that fixed gauge; this quantifier order is needed when comparing cells.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshS: Corner and private cases are assigned zero in this common-key helper; the identification theorem shifted_key explicitly excludes both kinds.
The explicit zero branches are justified by the flux-stream proposition in streamC_eq for nonnegative radius; the branch definition alone does not prove the physical boundary values.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.dataA: The extra scalar multiplies constant-pressure data; treating this theorem as strict linearity would erase the gauge shift that later mesh arguments remove.
notes.Breakdown.CellCert.Spectral.Internal.Mod: The conclusion is an equality for Lean’s total Bochner integral; this declaration has no separate integrability premise.
